verdict.rationale: Anytype documents exporting content at any time with a choice of Markdown or its own Any-Block format, and says users can leave with their data. That gives an open-format exit path. However, native storage is not an open format: community users report opaque Electron blob files and no raw Markdown or CSV files on disk, and the evidence does not document Any-Block as an open JSON spec. Missing for 10: a documented open JSON export or schema, evidence on export fidelity for properties, relations and types, an open on-disk storage format, and independent hands-on confirmation of export completeness.

support.subject: As a researcher, my notes are stored or exportable in open, documented formats (Markdown, JSON) so my archive outlives the vendor

citations.quote: Choose your preferred format: Markdown or Any-Block.
You can import content into your spaces and export it at any time.
You can leave anytime. Your data goes with you, and Anytype can't stop you.
